sources.compactness: GAME_DESIGN §24: compactação 10-15 m defendendo / 20-25 m atacando entre linhas; a 4-4-2 has two gaps, so the defensive-to-attacking line depth is ~20-30 m defending and ~40-50 m attacking. Ranges include the lag of real positions behind targets and marking pulling players out of line
sources.oscillation: TEST_PLAN §IA: sem oscilação de intenção. Counted: a player going A->B->A between positional intentions (hold shape, support, mark, press) within the window, with no change of possession in between. DESIGN ESTIMATE for the tolerated rate
sources.bunch: TEST_PLAN §IA: sem bolo (limite de jogadores do mesmo time perto da bola fora de disputa). DESIGN ESTIMATE
sources.positioning: TEST_PLAN §IA: Posicionamento baixo -> maior erro médio de alvo (AiTargetError 2.8 m at 30 vs 0.6 m at 90 in effects.json)
